patch: m6rest: local registry patch for t-2026-11-13-mettadinc-m6-rest (beyond-release only; every shape here is ours, not in the specification)

Of.doc: the machine whose state is forked (spec 3.4: fork x -> (x, x))

Merge.doc: a Merge port label of that machine (spec l.2976 (Merge label map)); the merge that reconciles the forks

Shared.doc: status of the correspondence saying which distinctions the forks share (receipt identities), with the KernelHive Correspondence statuses (spec 10.5 l.2964-2967, 3018)

Fork.doc: Ours (M6-rest merge model). An Implementation (Over F) is merge-dependent: Shared Unmeasured -> Unknown; Shared Measured -> evaluated exactly as without a fork.

Over.doc: (Over Fork): the implementation is merge-dependent on that fork (ours, M6-rest; replaces M6's ReceiptIdentities flag, which now answers InvalidInput)

fields: dual value y -- LeastCoherentRefinement dual row x_ab + x_bc - x_ac <= 1 on an identified pair (a, c); covers ab and bc by +y and ac by -y (ours, M6-rest)
(Path n1 .. nk) -- CompleteHive: unmeasured entry (a, b) filled with 1, forced by a path of measured identifications (ours, M6-rest; hive decision 2)
Member j -- CompleteHive: unmeasured member pair that no measured path joins; its entries stay 0, the least value (marked, not silent zero-fill; ours, M6-rest)

notes.m6rest-shapes: Shapes invented by M6-rest (beyond release only): (Fork F (Of Machine) (Merge label) (Shared Measured|Unmeasured)); Implementation (Over F); Unknown evidence (Open (Fork F (Of M) (Merge l) (Shared Unmeasured))); LeastCoherentRefinement certificate (Method LinearProgram) (EdgeMass v) and Chord dual rows. CompleteHive certificate (Method PathComposition) (Optimality Checked) (UnmeasuredEntries n) (Filled (Fill a b (Path ..))..) (NoPaths (NoPath Mi Mj)..); Value = alignment cost (sum w_a w_b over filled ordered pairs). Semantics: hive decision 2, our reading of spec l.2896-2906 (ref [2] Prop 9.3 unavailable). (Associator Hive Mi Mj Mk) -> HiveAssociator (request and result shape ours; definition spec l.2827).

Associator.claim: associator [i, j, k] = c_ik - c_ij o c_jk of a kernel hive (definition spec Def 10.1 l.2827; request shape ours, M6-rest)

HiveAssociator.doc: ours (M6-rest): crisp associator entries over V_i x V_k; Zero True iff the direct correspondence equals the composite through j
